key_expressions: How are your college friends doing?,
Did you make any close friends?,
Do your class styles match well?,

A: How are your college friends doing?
Oh really? You became close pretty fast! What kind of friend is it?
Nice! I’d love to meet them sometime.
B: They’re great. I’m getting close to people faster than I expected!
A friend from my major—very easy to talk to.
Yeah! I think you’d get along well too.

A: Is there someone you hang out with most these days?
Oh, so you got close while doing assignments together!
That’s good. You’ll get even closer if you keep studying together.
B: Yes, I have a friend I usually do assignments with.
Yeah, we got close quickly because we worked together a lot.
True! It feels more comfortable each time.

A: Who do you usually eat lunch with?
Oh, that friend you kept seeing at the cafeteria!
Nice. Friendships like that last long.
B: Usually with someone who finishes class at the same time.
We kept running into each other at the cafeteria, so we naturally ate together.
Yeah, we get along really well!

A: Do you have a friend whose study style matches yours?
Oh nice, someone who asks questions and helps each other!
Yeah, studying with someone like that really helps.
B: Yes, there’s someone I really focus well with.
We ask each other lots of questions too.
Yep, it helps a lot when we study together.

A: Is there someone you keep running into on campus?
Wow really? Those coincidences are funny!
Next time, try talking to them a bit!
B: Yes! Somehow we always cross paths in the same place.
I know, our schedules aren’t even similar but we keep running into each other.
If I see them again, I’ll say hi!

A: Did you find someone you can talk to comfortably about your major?
Ah, having someone to share those worries with is so reassuring!
Yeah, you two will support each other a lot.
B: Yes, there’s a friend I talk with about study concerns.
Yeah, it turns out we struggle with similar things.
Right, I think that made us closer!

A: Do you have a friend you prepare for exams with?
Oh that’s great! Helping each other must make things easier.
Yeah, if you work well together, keep studying together.
B: Yes, I have a friend I always study with during exam season.
We explain things to each other when one of us doesn’t get it.
Yeah, it’s so much better than studying alone!

A: Who do you get along with the best so far?
Wow, matching personalities and similar tastes—that’s perfect!
Nice, friendships like that really last long.
B: Probably the friend I share classes with.
Yes, we have similar tastes and our personalities match well.
Yeah, it’s really easy to talk with them!

A: Do you have plans to meet your friends this week?
Oh that sounds fun! You’ll probably eat something good too.
Tell me how it went afterward!
B: Yes, we’re having dinner together on Saturday.
We might try a new restaurant that opened recently.
I’ll tell you everything afterward!

A: Maybe I could join you all next time?
Wow, that sounds great! Seems like they’re all friendly.
Nice! Let me know if a plan comes up.
B: Of course! Everyone’s really easygoing.
Yeah, I think you’d get along with them right away.
Sure, I’ll tell you as soon as we make plans!
